quote: And so our mothers and grandmothers have, more often than not anonymously, handed on the creative spark, the seed of the flower they themselves never hoped to see: or like a sealed letter they could not plainly read.
source: Alice Walker, In Search of Our Mothers’ Gardens, the title essay (Harcourt Brace Jovanovich, 1983)
